articles.title: Prioritizing Proton Therapy for Pelvic Nodal Irradiation in Prostate Cancer
articles.summary: At the 2026 ASTRO Annual Meeting, clinicians discussed when proton therapy may be most justified over advanced photon approaches for intermediate- to very high-risk prostate cancer, with particular attention to pelvic nodal irradiation and reducing dose to nearby bowel.

articles.title: Stanford Radiation Oncology Showcases Research and Awards at ASTRO 2026
articles.summary: Stanford Cancer Institute highlighted advances presented at ASTRO 2026 spanning AI, cancer treatment, and precision oncology, reflecting the continued integration of computational methods with radiation oncology research.

articles.title: National Proton Conference Highlights Advances and Expanding Access
articles.summary: The National Association for Proton Therapy continues to highlight developments in proton therapy, new clinical programs, technology, and efforts to expand access across the United States.
